claims: Rabbi Hidary explains the division of the Lehem HaPanim among the priestly families in the Bet HaMikdash on Sukkot and other holidays.
He discusses the order of Berakhot for Lesheb BaSukkah and Shehecheyanu on the first and second nights of Sukkot.
summary: Rabbi Hidary explains the division of the Lehem HaPanim among the priestly families in the Bet HaMikdash on Sukkot and other holidays. He discusses the order of Berakhot for Lesheb BaSukkah and Shehecheyanu on the first and second nights of Sukkot. He also examines the penalties placed on the priestly family of Bilga due to the actions of Miriam bat Bilga and their neglect of service.
subjects: Menelaus and the Book of Maccabees
questions: Why is Lehem HaPanim divided among all twenty-four priestly families on Sukkot?
Which Berakha comes first on the first night of Sukkot, Lesheb BaSukkah or Shehecheyanu?
Why is the order of Berakhot reversed on the second night of Sukkot outside Israel?
What penalties were placed on the priestly clan of Bilga in the Bet HaMikdash?
Why did Miriam bat Bilga kick the Mizbeach and mock the sacrifices?
